mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, increasing mefloquine plasma concentrations and risk of neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity; both drugs also have independent CNS and cardiac effects that may be potentiated.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if coadministration necessary, monitor closely for neuropsychiatric symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias, and consider alternative antimalarial agents or fibrate therapy.
